AddOrganizationMember.description_en: Creates an account and directly adds it as a member
AddOrganizationMember.description_zh: 创建账号并直接添加成员

BatchAssignSeats.description_en: Assigns seats in batches to the member level
BatchAssignSeats.description_zh: 批量分配席位至成员层

CreateApiKey.description_en: Before using large models or applications in Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, create an API key as an authentication credential
CreateApiKey.description_zh: 使用阿里云百炼的大模型或应用前，请先创建 API Key 作为鉴权凭证

CreateTokenPlanInviteLink.description_en: Creates a TokenPlan member invitation link

DeleteApiKey.description_en: Deletes an authentication credential API key
DeleteApiKey.description_zh: 删除鉴权凭证 API Key

GetApiKey.description_en: Retrieves the information about a specified API key
GetApiKey.description_zh: 获取指定的鉴权凭证 API Key 信息

GetOrganization.description_en: Retrieves information about a specified organization

GetOrganizationMemberSeatStats.description_en: Queries organization member statistics information, including the total number of members, the number of administrators, the number of regular members, the number of members with allocated seats, and the number of members without allocated seats
GetOrganizationMemberSeatStats.description_zh: 查询组织成员统计信息，包含成员总数、管理员数、普通成员数、已分配席位成员数、未分配席位成员数

GetSubscriptionStats.description_en: Queries the number of members and seats for member management
GetSubscriptionStats.description_zh: 成员管理 - 成员数量和席位数量情况展示

GetTokenPlanAccountDetail.description_en: Retrieves the TokenPlan account details and organization information
GetTokenPlanAccountDetail.description_zh: 获取TokenPlan账号详情及组织信息

GetTokenPlanInviteLink.description_en: Retrieves the TokenPlan member invitation link

GetTokenPlanOrgInviteConfig.description_en: Retrieves the TokenPlan member invitation configuration

ListApiKeys.description_en: Retrieves a list of API key information for authentication credentials
ListApiKeys.description_zh: 获取鉴权凭证 API Key 信息列表

ListModelLimits.description_en: Queries model throttling configurations for a workspace
ListModelLimits.description_zh: 查询业务空间模型限流

ListModelPermissions.description_en: Queries model authorizations for a workspace
ListModelPermissions.description_zh: 查询业务空间模型授权

ListModels.description_en: 模型元数据-查询基础模型列表

ListOrganizationMembers.description_en: Queries the list of organization members (including seat information). Supports filtering by name, status, and seat assignment, and supports pagination
ListOrganizationMembers.description_zh: 查询组织成员列表（含席位信息），支持按名称、状态、是否分配席位过滤，支持分页

ListSubscriptionSharedPackages.description_en: Queries the details of shared packages by paging

ListWorkspaces.description_en: Retrieves the list of business workspaces

RemoveOrganizationMember.description_en: Removes organization members. Before removal, checks whether the member holds a seat. If the member holds a seat, the removal is rejected
RemoveOrganizationMember.description_zh: 移除组织成员，移除前检查成员是否持有席位，持有席位则拒绝移除

RevokeTokenPlanInviteLink.description_en: Revokes a TokenPlan member invitation link

SetTokenPlanOrgInviteConfig.description_en: Configures the member invitation settings for a TokenPlan

UpdateApiKey.description_en: Edits the information of an authentication credential API key
UpdateApiKey.description_zh: 编辑鉴权凭证 API Key 信息

UpdateModelLimits.description_en: Updates the model throttling configuration for a workspace
UpdateModelLimits.description_zh: 更新业务空间模型限流

UpdateModelPermissions.description_en: Updates model authorization for a workspace
UpdateModelPermissions.description_zh: 更新业务空间模型授权

UpdateOrganizationMember.description_en: Modifies the roles of organization members
